MOSSSharedCanvas: MOSS BBOX Canvas: manual five-color layout using the installed Krea2 shared UI.

MOSSBBoxCanvas: Legacy separate MOSS BBOX Canvas; retained for existing workflows.
MOSSBBoxPrompter: Legacy separate MOSS BBOX Prompter; retained for existing workflows.
